title: Heavy-traffic limit of stationary distributions of a state-dependent queue
summary: Inspired by the work of Atar and Miyazawa [1] (2026) as well as applications to energy-saving problems, we are interested in the heavy-traffic limit of the stationary queue length distribution, which is not addressed in [1]. In this paper, we consider this heavy-traffic limit for the single server queue which has the most general possible state-dependence. Namely, arrival and service speeds may take any values depending on the queue length. Here, the terminology, heavy-traffic limit, stands for a diffusion-scaled limit in heavy-traffic for processes, distributions and modeling primitives.…
